# dsh-tui-status-rotator

> A port of dsh-status-rotator's **rotating status line** to dsh-TUI.
>
> Phase-aware phrases · type
writer reveal · theme-adaptive gradient · weighted shuffle-bag anti-repeat · 14 phrase packs (1362 e

ntries) · conditional phrases & live placeholders · presets and weekday schedule.
>
> Wired into dsh
-TUI's native `/settings` section and `/status-rotator` command - install and go.
中文 · Install · First run · What it looks like · Settings · Commands · Advanced config · Differences
· Troubleshooting · Development · Documents
## Install
### Requirements
| Dependency | Version / notes |

| dsh-TUI | **v0.16+** (uses the `tuiStatus.registerView` and `tuiSettingsSections` seams) |
| DeepS
eek Harness | verified on 0.2.1-rc.2; older hosts may lack seams (the plugin degrades with diagnosti

cs) |
| Node.js | `^22.19 || >=24` |
| pnpm | `>=10` (used by `dsh plugin` when installing) |
| Term
inal | must be a **real TTY** (Windows Terminal WSL tab, VS Code terminal, ...); stdout must not be

piped/redirected |
| Model auth | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` or `/auth login deepseek-account` (detected by
the dsh-tui onboarding) |
The package ships `dsh-plugin.json` (Community v0.15 declaration surface) and `cordis.patch.yml` (pr
ofile composition row).
### Install from GitHub
[代码示例省略，未执行]
If the `dsh-tui` profile does not exist yet, install the host first: `dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui a
dd @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui`. If DSH reports an incompatible host dependency, run the printed `
dsh plugin allow-version ... --accept-risk` and retry.
### After install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The first launch runs a 4-step onboarding (API key / language / model / shortcuts). Choose Chinese t
o switch the status phrases to Chinese as well.
### Uninstall
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`remove` does **not** delete user data: the external bank and caches stay in `~/.dsh-tui/status-rota
tor/`. See Uninstall and data.
## First run
After launching, send any prompt and run these three checks within 30 seconds:
1. **The line appears**: one extra row above the prompt with a phase glyph - `◌` (thinking) / `●` (r

unning) / `◍` (long) - typed out and color-shifting.
2. **The command works**: type `/status-rotator
status`; expect one line like:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
3. **The settings page exists**: open `/settings` -> "Status rotator" page (15 fields).
> **Only two characters at first, looks stuck?** That is a typewriter mid-frame (30 ms/grapheme by d
efault; a full phrase takes ~0.3-0.6 s). To show whole phrases at once, set `/settings -> Status rot
ator -> typewriter speed` to `0`.
## What it looks like
While a turn runs, a line above the prompt rotates (real TTY frame examples; `◌` / `●` / `◍` are the
ns, a line above the prompt rotates (real TTY frame examples; `◌` / `●` / `◍` are the phase glyphs):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
(Both are real entries from the shipped corpus; see `src/bank/packs/`.)

- Typewriter reveal; after the phrase settles it rotates at the configured interval;
- Each grapheme

is colored from a flowing palette (host theme palette by default, adapts to light/dark themes);
- P

hase transitions (thinking ◌ -> running ● -> long ◍) swap the phrase immediately;
- Idle sessions, f
inished turns, disabled plugin: the line renders nothing - no placeholder row, no flicker, no focus

stealing;
- Coexists with the host's own working-activity line: this plugin only adds its own row, i
t never overwrites the host text.
## Settings
`/settings` gains a **"Status rotator"** page (seam `tuiSettingsSections`). Every field applies live
and is persisted through the host's revision-fenced settings writes - no restart needed; reverting
a value to its default also removes the profile override.
| Field | Default | Range | Meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | on/off | Master switch; off renders nothing |
| `language` | `auto` | auto /

zh / en | Phrase language; auto reads `DSH_TUI_LANG` -> `~/.dsh-tui/lang.json` -> system locale |
|

`intervalMs` | `10000` | 500-600000 | Rotation interval (ms) |
| `typeSpeedMs` | `30` | 0-2000 | Typ

ewriter per-grapheme interval; 0 = instant |
| `thinkingMs` | `15000` | 0-600000 | "thinking" phase

duration before "running" |
| `longAfterMs` | `60000` | 0-3600000 | "long" phase threshold |
| `weig

htedRandom` | `true` | on/off | Weighted draw; off = uniform |
| `antiRepeatRecentLimit` | `3` | 0-5

0 | Cross-bag recency memory (0 = bag-only) |
| `labelSource` | `phrases` | phrases / host | `host`

= leave the host line untouched |
| `gradientEnabled` | `true` | on/off | Per-cell flowing gradient

|
| `gradientMode` | `theme` | theme / day / night | `theme` = host theme keys (adapts); day/night =

custom palettes |
| `gradientDirection` | `rtl` | rtl / ltr | Flow direction |
| `gradientColors` |
original night palette | >= 2 colors | Custom night palette (hex / rgb() / ansi256() / ansi:name /

host theme key, comma separated) |
| `gradientDayColors` | original day palette | >= 2 colors | Cust

om day palette |
| `gradientSpeedSec` | `4` | 1-60 | Seconds per gradient cycle |
Nested structures (`presets` / `schedule` / `enabledPacks` / `bankPath`) are edited in the profile r
ow config (see Advanced config), not the declarative form.
## Commands
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Registered through dsh-commands; the mediated host surface (`tuiPluginHost.registerCommand`) is pref
erred when present so ownership and authorization checks apply.
## Advanced config
Add keys to the plugin row in the profile patch:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- **Packs**: 14 built-in packs (1362 entries, default 10 enabled = 945), ported verbatim from the we

b plugin;
- **Conditions / weights / rarity**: entries accept `{ text, weight, when, rarity }`; `whe
n` supports `tool` / `retry` / `pending` / `phase` / `hour` / `firstTurn`, and matching conditionals

win the draw;
